. Two allies: restore 4 HP each on Weak, 7 HP each on Standard, 10 HP each on Strong. Reduce the restored amount by each target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying creature cannot be targeted; stabilize it first. This restores no wounds and cannot reverse Last Words.
